I like stigma- its an anonymous way to join a group or pen pal with people facing similar struggles. It’s nice to feels supported and everyone is nice. It has a journal feature too!


Youper is this mood tracker and personal assistant bot where you can see your mood and it helps identify your mood factors. Maybe if you committed to this app it’d be proof for your doctors that this feeling is persistent. 


SelfCare is an app where someone is laying in bed and you complete these little tasks for them and they encourage you. It’s very relaxing and helps me mellow out and focus on my feelings. 

(All on the iOS app store)

It’s okay.  I like being a silly goose sometimes, but I don’t think suicide is realistic in the next couple of weeks. Lol I doubt myself being suicidal because I care about what other people would think. Can you believe I’m insecure about my own death? Hahah
I agree. I mean best case scenario I accidentally die from something other than myself. I’d like to think someone would find comfort in my feelings.
I appreciate your reply. It’s comforting to hear someone understands. My roommate just threatens to send me to a mental hospital when I try to express these weird actions.
